warning_on_hardware_extrapolation: JVM microbenchmarks do NOT directly equal physical ARM64 SoC timings under CPU governor thermal throttling. Physical hardware latency must be measured on real hardware.

claim_evaluation.evaluation: Warm lookup and matching consistently operate under 1 ms (p95 = 0.58 ms). However, cold lookups with JIT compilation or cache misses can spike to 2.40 ms (p99). Claim is therefore SCIENTIFICALLY QUALIFIED: '< 2 ms for warm in-memory antibody cross-matching; cold initialization may exceed 2 ms on constrained hardware'.
